summary.text: Mark Davis is a U.S. Air Force veteran and small-business owner running with no party affiliation for the open 16th District seat. His campaign materials describe him as a political newcomer who moved to Florida about four years ago and entered the race after a public confrontation with the governor over health care. He is running on health care, economic security and what he calls accountability in government.

paragraphs.text: Earned a high school diploma from Western High School.
Served in the U.S. Air Force from 2005 to 2013.
Describes himself as a father, veteran and small-business owner who has worked in healthcare; his campaign website says he moved to Florida about four years ago.
Says he is not a politician and built an online following before running; WGCU reports that he is an Air Force veteran and small-business owner.

WWSB reported that Davis was arrested on July 28, 2026, for obstructing an officer without violence during a court-ordered welfare check of his children by Department of Children and Families investigators. Davis told ABC7 the complaint is false and is retaliation for his criticism of President Trump and Gov. DeSantis. This is a misdemeanor charge, not a conviction.
